en: A black-and-white image of an old library or study room, filled with bookshelves that are packed with books. There is a large candelabra or lamp visible near the center of the image, and a table in the lower right corner covered with papers and books. The photograph has a vintage quality, likely from the early-to-mid 20th century. There is no visible text on the postcard.
